scanNote:
11-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (78-bet) - GRAMMATIKA.

Yuqorida chapda QIZIL yorliqda oq '11' va 'Our Precious Planet'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Conditionals Type 2'.
9) 'Study the sentences below and answer the questions which follow.' a) 'When I am the leader of my country, I will ban cars.' b) 'If I were the leader of my country, I would ban cars.' 1 Which sentence was spoken by a child, and which by a politician? 2 Which sentence is about a real or very likely situation in the future? 3 Which sentence is about an unreal or highly unlikely situation in the present or future? 4 How do the two sentences differ in form?
   OCh KO'K quti, oq katta harflar 'If ... + past simple + ... would/could/might + bare infinitive': • 'We use CONDITIONALS TYPE 2 to talk about unreal or highly unlikely situations in the present or future. NOTE: We can use WERE in all persons (after I/he/she/it). If I WERE the leader of my country, I WOULD NOT ALLOW hunters to kill endangered species.'
10) 'Read the short texts in Ex. 5 and underline all sentences which include conditionals type 2.'
11) 'Make sentences using the prompts, as in the example.' SURATLAR: velosipedli qiz; qora axlat chelagi; ko'lda o'rdaklar; (o'ng ustunda) qog'oz qaytarish qutisiga qog'oz tashlayotgan ayol; daraxt tagida ayiqcha.
   1 we all use bicycles → there not be so much air pollution. Ko'k qiya: "If we all used bicycles, there wouldn't be so much air pollution."
   2 there be more bins in towns and cities → there not be so much litter on our streets
   3 we not pollute lakes and rivers → we have clean drinking water
   (O'NG USTUN:) 4 we recycle all of our waste → rubbish not pollute environment
   5 we stop cutting down rainforests → fewer plants and animals die

O'NG USTUN:
12) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form.' 1 If you ...... (take) your bicycle, you would get there faster. 2 If he lived in the countryside, he ...... (be) happier. 3 If we ...... (ask) her, I'm sure she would stop doing that. 4 If people ...... (not/drop) litter on beaches, our beaches would be much cleaner. 5 If you ...... (go) there by bus, you would get there more quickly. 6 If people ...... (stop) using aerosols, it would help the environment. 7 If hunters stopped killing so many tigers, they ...... (not/be) an endangered species. 8 If Veronica ...... (walk) to work, she wouldn't be so unfit. 9 If people ...... (not/use) so much paper, there would be more rainforests. 10 If people shared their cars, there ...... (be) fewer cars on the roads.
13) Kasseta belgisi: 'You will hear four people talking about environmental problems and solutions. Match the speakers (1-4) to the pictures (A-D). There is one extra picture that you do not need.' BESh SURAT: A - qiz gazetalarni bog'lamoqda (qog'oz qayta ishlash); B - shisha butilkalar (shisha qayta ishlash); C - benzin quyish (yoqilg'i); D - axlat uyumi (chiqindi); E - kimyoviy modda bochkalari.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '78'.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the sentences below and answer the questions which follow. a) "When I am the leader of my country, I will ban cars." b) "If I were the leader of my country, I would ban cars."
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplarni o'rganing va keyingi savollarga javob bering. a) "Mamlakatim rahbari bo'lganimda mashinalarni taqiqlayman." b) "Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim."
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GAP - IKKI DUNYo.

  a) 'WHEN I AM ... I WILL' -
     REAL: siyosatchi (u haqiqatan
     rahbar bo'ladi)
  b) 'IF I WERE ... I WOULD' -
     XAYoLIY: bola (rahbar bo'lishi
     ehtimoldan yiroq)


⚠ 'A POLITICIAN':

  = siyosatchi.
  ⚠ 'politics' = siyosat.


⚠ 'UNLIKELY':

  = ehtimoldan yiroq.
  ⚠ 'likely' = ehtimol.
  ⚠ 'highly unlikely' = juda
  ehtimoldan yiroq.

items.en: 1 Which sentence was spoken by a child, and which by a politician?
items.uz: 1 Qaysi gapni bola, qaysisini siyosatchi aytgan?
items.answerEn: Sentence b) was spoken by a child; sentence a) was spoken by a politician.
items.answerUz: b) gapni bola, a) gapni siyosatchi aytgan.

items.en: 2 Which sentence is about a real or very likely situation in the future?
items.uz: 2 Qaysi gap kelajakdagi real yoki juda ehtimolli vaziyat haqida?

items.en: 3 Which sentence is about an unreal or highly unlikely situation in the present or future?
items.uz: 3 Qaysi gap hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy yoki ehtimoldan yiroq vaziyat haqida?

items.en: 4 How do the two sentences differ in form?
items.uz: 4 Ikki gap shakl jihatidan qanday farq qiladi?
items.answerEn: Sentence a) uses 'when' + present simple and 'will' + infinitive. Sentence b) uses 'if' + past simple and 'would' + infinitive.
items.answerUz: a) gapda 'when' + hozirgi oddiy zamon va 'will' + fe'l. b) gapda 'if' + o'tgan oddiy zamon va 'would' + fe'l.

exercises.instructionEn: If ... + past simple + ... would/could/might + bare infinitive
exercises.instructionUz: If ... + o'tgan oddiy zamon + ... would/could/might + 'to' siz fe'l
exercises.explanationUz:
2-TUR ShART GAPLARI - 11-UNITNING
ASOSIY GRAMMATIKASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  IF + PAST SIMPLE,
  WOULD/COULD/MIGHT + FE'L (to siz)

  'If I WERE the leader, I WOULD
   NOT ALLOW hunters ...'
  'If we USED bicycles, there
   WOULDN'T BE so much pollution.'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MA'NOSI                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  XAYoLIY yoki EhTIMOLDAN YIROQ
  vaziyat - HOZIR yoki KELAJAKDA.

  ⚠ 'If I were rich' - men boy
  EMASMAN (xayol).
  ⚠ Past simple bo'lsa ham O'TMISh
  haqida EMAS!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  1-TUR va 2-TUR FARQI            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1-TUR (real):
     If it RAINS, I WILL stay home.
     (yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin)
  2-TUR (xayoliy):
     If it RAINED in the desert,
     plants WOULD grow.
     (cho'lda yomg'ir - ehtimoldan
      yiroq)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  'WERE' - HAMMA ShAXSDA          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'If I WERE you ...'
  'If he WERE rich ...'
  ⚠ 'was' ham to'g'ri (so'zlashuv),
  lekin 'were' rasmiy va odatiy.
  ⚠ 'If I were you, I would ...' =
  sening o'rningda bo'lsam - MASLAHAT
  qolipi!


⚠ 'BARE INFINITIVE':

  = 'to' siz infinitiv (fe'lning
  asosiy shakli).
  ⚠ 'would TO ban' - XATO!


⚠ QISQARTMALAR:

  I'd = I would; wouldn't = would
  not.

points.en: We use conditionals type 2 to talk about unreal or highly unlikely situations in the present or future.
points.uz: 2-tur shart gaplarini hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy yoki ehtimoldan yiroq vaziyatlar haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.

points.en: NOTE: We can use were in all persons (after I/he/she/it).
points.uz: ESLATMA: 'were' ni barcha shaxslarda ishlatishimiz mumkin (I/he/she/it dan keyin).
points.noteUz: ⚠ 'If I WERE', 'If she WERE' - rasmiy shakl.

points.en: If I were the leader of my country, I would not allow hunters to kill endangered species.
points.uz: Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, ovchilarga xavf ostidagi turlarni o'ldirishga ruxsat bermasdim.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the short texts in Ex. 5 and underline all sentences which include conditionals type 2.
exercises.instructionUz: 5-mashqdagi qisqa matnlarni o'qing va 2-tur shart gaplari bo'lgan barcha gaplar tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
77-BETDAGI 2-TUR ShART GAPLARI:

  ROBERTA:
  • 'If I were leader of my country,
    I would ban cars ...'
  • 'If they did, our cities would
    be healthier places ...'

  JAMES:
  • "If I were the leader of my
    country, I wouldn't allow
    hunters ..."

  MARIA:
  • 'If I were the leader of my
    country, I would stop logging
    companies ...'
  • 'If they did that, it could
    save the rainforest ...'

  ⚠ Beshta gap.
  ⚠ 'could' ham 2-turda ishlatiladi
  ('it COULD save').

points.en: Roberta: If I were leader of my country, I would ban cars ... / If they did, our cities would be healthier places to live in.
James: If I were the leader of my country, I wouldn't allow hunters to kill endangered species.
Maria: If I were the leader of my country, I would stop logging companies ... / If they did that, it could save the rainforest ...

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences using the prompts, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  "If we all USED bicycles, there
   WOULDN'T BE so much air
   pollution."


TO'LIQ JAVOBLAR:

  2 If there WERE more bins in towns
    and cities, there WOULDN'T BE so
    much litter on our streets.
  3 If we DIDN'T POLLUTE lakes and
    rivers, we WOULD HAVE clean
    drinking water.
  4 If we RECYCLED all of our waste,
    rubbish WOULDN'T POLLUTE the
    environment.
  5 If we STOPPED cutting down
    rainforests, FEWER plants and
    animals WOULD DIE.


⚠ 'THERE WERE':

  'If there WERE more bins' - 'there
  is' ning past simple shakli.


⚠ 'LITTER':

  = axlat (ko'chada tashlangan).
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'to drop litter' = axlat tashlamoq.


⚠ 'A BIN':

  = axlat qutisi.


⚠ 'TO RECYCLE':

  = qayta ishlamoq.
  ⚠ 'recycling' = qayta ishlash.


⚠ 'WASTE':

  = chiqindi.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'rubbish' = axlat (Britaniya).


⚠ 'FEWER':

  = kamroq (SANALADIGAN bilan).
  ⚠ 'fewer plants and animals'.
  ⚠ 'less' - sanalmaydigan bilan.
exercises.exampleEn: If we all used bicycles, there wouldn't be so much air pollution.
exercises.exampleUz: Agar hammamiz velosiped ishlatsak, havo ifloslanishi shunchalik ko'p bo'lmasdi.
modelAnswers: If we all used bicycles, there wouldn't be so much air pollution.
If there were more bins in towns and cities, there wouldn't be so much litter on our streets.
If we didn't pollute lakes and rivers, we would have clean drinking water.
If we recycled all of our waste, rubbish wouldn't pollute the environment.
If we stopped cutting down rainforests, fewer plants and animals would die.
modelAnswersUz: Agar hammamiz velosiped ishlatsak, havo ifloslanishi shunchalik ko'p bo'lmasdi.
Agar shahar va qishloqlarda ko'proq axlat qutisi bo'lsa, ko'chalarimizda shunchalik ko'p axlat bo'lmasdi.
Agar ko'l va daryolarni ifloslantirmasak, toza ichimlik suvimiz bo'lardi.
Agar barcha chiqindilarimizni qayta ishlasak, axlat atrof-muhitni ifloslantirmasdi.
Agar tropik o'rmonlarni kesishni to'xtatsak, kamroq o'simlik va hayvon o'lardi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOIDA:
  'if' bo'lagida → PAST SIMPLE
  asosiy gapda → WOULD + fe'l


JAVOBLAR:

  1 If you TOOK your bicycle ...
  2 ... he WOULD BE happier.
  3 If we ASKED her ...
  4 If people DIDN'T DROP litter ...
  5 If you WENT there by bus ...
  6 If people STOPPED using
    aerosols ...
  7 ... they WOULDN'T BE an
    endangered species.
  8 If Veronica WALKED to work ...
  9 If people DIDN'T USE so much
    paper ...
  10 ... there WOULD BE fewer cars.


⚠ QAYSI BO'LAK?

  'If' dan keyin → past simple
  (took, asked, went, ...)
  'If' siz bo'lak → would (would be)


⚠ 'AN AEROSOL':

  = aerozol (sprey).
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈeərəsɒl/.


⚠ 'UNFIT':

  = sog'lom emas, jismonan zaif.
  ⚠ 'fit' = sog'lom, chiniqqan.


⚠ 'TO SHARE A CAR':

  = mashinada birga yurmoq
  (car-sharing).

items.textEn: 1 If you ___ (take) your bicycle, you would get there faster.
2 If he lived in the countryside, he ___ (be) happier.
3 If we ___ (ask) her, I'm sure she would stop doing that.
4 If people ___ (not/drop) litter on beaches, our beaches would be much cleaner.
5 If you ___ (go) there by bus, you would get there more quickly.
6 If people ___ (stop) using aerosols, it would help the environment.
7 If hunters stopped killing so many tigers, they ___ (not/be) an endangered species.
8 If Veronica ___ (walk) to work, she wouldn't be so unfit.
9 If people ___ (not/use) so much paper, there would be more rainforests.
10 If people shared their cars, there ___ (be) fewer cars on the roads.

exercises.instructionEn: You will hear four people talking about environmental problems and solutions. Match the speakers (1-4) to the pictures (A-D). There is one extra picture that you do not need.
exercises.instructionUz: Atrof-muhit muammolari va yechimlari haqida gapirayotgan to'rt kishini eshitasiz. Gapiruvchilarni (1-4) suratlarga (A-D) moslang. Bitta ortiqcha surat bor.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - to'rt gapiruvchi
faqat yozuvdan.


BESh SURAT:

  A - qog'oz qayta ishlash (qiz
      gazetalarni bog'lamoqda)
  B - shisha butilkalar (shisha
      qayta ishlash)
  C - benzin quyish (yoqilg'i,
      mashina tutuni)
  D - axlat uyumi (chiqindi)
  E - kimyoviy bochkalar (zaharli
      chiqindi)

  ⚠ Bittasi ORTIQChA.


⚠ 'ENVIRONMENTAL':

  = atrof-muhitga oid.
  ⚠ 'environmental problems' =
  ekologik muammolar.


⚠ 'EXTRA':

  = ortiqcha, qo'shimcha.

points.en: A - recycling paper (girl tying up newspapers)
C - filling a car with petrol (car fumes)

patterns.formula: If + ega + PAST SIMPLE, ega + would + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: If we all used bicycles, there wouldn't be so much air pollution.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar hammamiz velosiped ishlatsak, havo ifloslanishi shunchalik ko'p bo'lmasdi.

patterns.formula: If I were [kim], I would + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: If I were the leader of my country, I would ban cars.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim.

patterns.formula: If there were [nima], there wouldn't be [nima].
patterns.exampleEn: If there were more bins, there wouldn't be so much litter.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar ko'proq axlat qutisi bo'lsa, shunchalik ko'p axlat bo'lmasdi.

patterns.exampleEn: When I am the leader of my country, I will ban cars.
